raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "in-plane dimensions and aspect ratio",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Secs. 2.1 and 3.1 refer to Fig. 1(a) without giving dimensions. Sec. 2.3 specifies 100 x 100 finite elements, which does not itself establish physical cell dimensions or domain aspect ratio.",
      "readings": [
        "Square domain [0,L] x [0,L] with square cells",
        "Rectangular domain [0,2L] x [0,L] with rectangular cells",
        "Rectangular domain [0,L] x [0,2L] with rectangular cells"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "absolute in-plane length scale",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Neither the problem description nor the concluding statement of a 100 x 100 domain supplies physical lengths or units. This item concerns uniform rescaling with dimensionless geometry, load pattern and filter-to-cell ratio held fixed.",
      "readings": [
        "Reference length L = 1 mm",
        "Reference length L = 100 mm",
        "Reference length L = 1 in nondimensional units"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "uniform out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 2.1–2.3 give no thickness for converting a two-dimensional elastic model into stiffness and compliance.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform thickness t = 1 in consistent length units",
        "Uniform thickness t = 0.1 in the same length units"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "location of the built-in root",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The term cantilever identifies a built-in root, but Secs. 2.1 and 3.1 leave its location to Fig. 1(a). No supported edge or node set is described.",
      "readings": [
        "Clamp the left edge x = 0",
        "Clamp the right edge x = Lx",
        "Clamp the bottom edge y = 0",
        "Clamp the top edge y = Ly"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "extent of the clamped boundary",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The prose accompanying Fig. 1(a) does not identify how much of the root boundary is clamped. Each reading retains a clamp with both in-plane translations fixed.",
      "readings": [
        "Clamp every node along the entire root edge",
        "Clamp only the central half of the root edge",
        "Clamp two root-edge patches, each occupying one tenth of the edge length, at its two corners"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_position",
      "entity": "location of applied loading",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Secs. 2.1 and 3.1 give no load coordinates; Fig. 1(a) is the only problem-definition illustration. Let s run from the root to the free end and h across the beam height.",
      "readings": [
        "Free-end midpoint: (s/L,h/H) = (1,0.5)",
        "Lower free-end corner: (s/L,h/H) = (1,0)",
        "Upper free-end corner: (s/L,h/H) = (1,1)"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "spatial distribution and number of applied forces",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Calling the cantilever loading constant distinguishes it from design-dependent loading, but the text does not specify point forces, loaded patches, traction distributions or force count.",
      "readings": [
        "One concentrated nodal force",
        "Uniform traction over the entire free edge",
        "Uniform traction over a centered free-edge patch of height 0.1H",
        "Two equal concentrated forces at the two free-end corners"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "direction of applied loading",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "No force components or loading angle are stated for Fig. 1(a). Constancy does not specify direction.",
      "readings": [
        "Transverse loading perpendicular to the beam axis",
        "Axial loading parallel to the beam axis",
        "Oblique loading with equal axial and transverse components"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "overall loading amplitude",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No force or traction magnitude or units are supplied for the cantilever. This concerns a common multiplier of an otherwise fixed load pattern.",
      "readings": [
        "Total resultant force F = 1 N",
        "Total resultant force F = 100 N",
        "Unit resultant force in nondimensional units"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "other",
      "entity": "load-case grouping and compliance weights",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The compliance-minimization description does not explicitly state the number of load cases, whether multiple forces act simultaneously, or any weights for separate cases.",
      "readings": [
        "One load case containing all applied forces simultaneously",
        "Separate transverse and axial load cases with equally weighted summed compliance",
        "Separate transverse and axial load cases with compliance weights 1:2"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "volume fraction of the Fig. 3(b) target",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2.3 states the training sweep and Table 1 labels its four volume fractions, but neither the Fig. 3 caption nor Sec. 3.1 identifies which fraction produced Fig. 3(b).",
      "readings": [
        "Vf = 0.03",
        "Vf = 0.25",
        "Vf = 0.50",
        "Vf = 0.75"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "fixed-solid or fixed-void elements and their volume accounting",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 2.1–2.3 specify no passive-element masks, support or load pads, prescribed voids, or accounting convention for any passive material.",
      "readings": [
        "All 10000 elements are designable, with no passive regions",
        "One root-adjacent element column and a 3 x 3 load-adjacent pad are fixed solid and counted in the volume budget",
        "The same solid pads are excluded from a volume budget defined only over designable elements",
        "A central 10 x 10 element block is fixed void"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "overall solid elastic-stiffness scale",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No Young's modulus or equivalent stiffness scale is stated. A common stiffness multiplier only rescales compliance when elastic ratios and numerical void contrast are held fixed.",
      "readings": [
        "E0 = 1 in consistent nondimensional units",
        "E0 = 70 GPa",
        "E0 = 210 GPa"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Poisson's ratio",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No Poisson's ratio is supplied for an isotropic interpretation of the cantilever material.",
      "readings": [
        "nu = 0.20",
        "nu = 0.30",
        "nu = 0.35"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "planar constitutive model and elastic symmetry",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Naming top88 in Sec. 2.1 does not state a constitutive matrix within the supplied text. Neither plane stress versus plane strain nor isotropy is explicitly specified.",
      "readings": [
        "Isotropic plane stress",
        "Isotropic plane strain",
        "Orthotropic plane stress, with material axes along the beam, Ex/Ey = 2, Gxy/Ex = 0.2 and nuxy = 0.25"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "density-to-stiffness interpolation and void regularization",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2.3 fixes penal = 3, but gives no interpolation equation, residual stiffness or minimum density. Here C0 denotes the solid constitutive matrix.",
      "readings": [
        "C(rho) = [1e-9 + (1-1e-9)rho^3]C0, with 0 <= rho <= 1",
        "C(rho) = [1e-6 + (1-1e-6)rho^3]C0, with 0 <= rho <= 1",
        "C(rho) = rho^3 C0, with 0.001 <= rho <= 1"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "implementation of the specified filter inputs",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 2.3 explicitly supplies rmin = 2.4 and ft = 1, but does not define the flag, filtering equations, kernel, boundary normalization or distance metric for transferring these inputs to another solver.",
      "readings": [
        "Density-weighted sensitivity filtering with linear distance weights, radius 2.4 in grid-index units and normalization over in-domain neighbors",
        "Sensitivity filtering with uniform weights inside radius 2.4 in grid-index units",
        "Density filtering with linear distance weights and radius 2.4 in grid-index units",
        "Linear sensitivity filtering using physical Euclidean distances and radius 2.4 times the vertical cell pitch"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "initial design",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No starting density field or perturbation is specified for the top88 runs in Sec. 2.3.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform initial density rho = Vf",
        "Initial density Vf plus alternating +0.005 and -0.005 cell perturbations, preserving the mean volume fraction"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "optimization update method and numerical controls",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2.3 names top88 and lists three inputs, but does not state the update equations, move limits, damping or multiplier-search tolerances needed to reproduce the iteration path from the text.",
      "readings": [
        "Optimality-criteria update with move limit 0.2, square-root damping and multiplier-search tolerance 1e-3",
        "Optimality-criteria update with move limit 0.1, square-root damping and multiplier-search tolerance 1e-6",
        "MMA optimization with move limit 0.1"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "cantilever termination criterion and iteration cap",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No cantilever stopping rule or iteration cap is stated. The maxit = 100 in Sec. 2.3 belongs to the separate TOPress input group.",
      "readings": [
        "Stop when maximum element-density change is below 0.01",
        "Stop when maximum element-density change is below 0.001",
        "Stop after 200 optimization iterations"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "finite-element interpolation and quadrature",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2.3 fixes the mesh count at 100 x 100 elements but does not state element order, node arrangement or numerical integration.",
      "readings": [
        "100 x 100 bilinear four-node quadrilaterals with 2 x 2 Gauss integration",
        "100 x 100 four-node quadrilaterals with stabilized one-point integration",
        "100 x 100 biquadratic nine-node quadrilaterals with 3 x 3 Gauss integration"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "physical grid spacing",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The 100 x 100 element count does not explicitly specify uniform versus graded physical spacing.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform Cartesian spacing: x_i = Lx(i/100), y_j = Ly(j/100)",
        "Structured spacing graded toward the root: x_i = Lx(i/100)^2, y_j = Ly(j/100), with the root at x = 0"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "linear-elastic analysis solver accuracy",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The supplied text gives no linear-system solution method or residual tolerance. These do not alter the exact mathematical problem, but their effect on an exact numerical reproduction is undetermined.",
      "readings": [
        "Sparse direct solution to floating-point accuracy",
        "Iterative solution with relative residual tolerance 1e-8",
        "Iterative solution with relative residual tolerance 1e-3"
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    }
  ]
}
